% ============================================================================
%  Figure 7 -- Qualitative instance-segmentation comparison
%  Benchmarking Deep-Learning Instance-Segmentation Models for Stomatal
%  Phenotyping under Drought Stress in Chickpea (Cicer arietinum L.)
%
%  Compile:  pdflatex Figure7_qualitative.tex
%  Panels:   figassets3/f7_{control,drought}_{input,gt,yolov8,yolo26,mrcnn}.png
%            regenerated by tmp/regen_figure7_panels.py from the trained
%            weights and the locked test-set ground truth.
% ============================================================================

\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=17.6cm,paperheight=6.45cm,margin=0.3cm]{geometry}
\setlength{\topskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{helvet}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{tikz}
\graphicspath{{figassets3/}}
\pagestyle{empty}

\definecolor{ink}    {HTML}{191C21}
\definecolor{muted}  {HTML}{5A626E}
\definecolor{rule}   {HTML}{B8BFC8}
\definecolor{gcblue} {HTML}{0072B2}   % Okabe-Ito blue  -- guard-cell mask
\definecolor{poreorg}{HTML}{D55E00}   % Okabe-Ito orange -- pore mask

\newcommand{\colhd}{\fontsize{8.2}{9.6}\selectfont\bfseries}
\newcommand{\rowhd}{\fontsize{8.2}{9.6}\selectfont\bfseries}
\newcommand{\lgd}  {\fontsize{7.6}{9}\selectfont}

% panel geometry: label column 1.55 cm, then five 3.01 cm panels (4:3)
\newcommand{\pw}{3.01}
\newcommand{\ph}{2.26}

\newcommand{\panel}[3]{%  x, ytop, file
  \begin{scope}
    \clip[rounded corners=1.6pt] (#1,#2) rectangle ++(\pw,-\ph);
    \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0pt] at (#1,#2)
      {\includegraphics[width=\pw cm,height=\ph cm]{#3}};
  \end{scope}
  \draw[rounded corners=1.6pt, draw=rule, line width=0.4pt]
    (#1,#2) rectangle ++(\pw,-\ph);
}

\begin{document}%
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm]

% ---- column headers -------------------------------------------------------
\foreach \i/\t in {0/Input, 1/{Ground truth}, 2/YOLOv8s-seg,
                   3/YOLO26s-seg, 4/{Mask R-CNN}}{
  \node[anchor=north, font=\colhd, text=ink] at ({1.55+3.11*\i+1.505},-0.02) {\t};
}

% ---- row 1 : control ------------------------------------------------------
\foreach \i/\k in {0/input, 1/gt, 2/yolov8, 3/yolo26, 4/mrcnn}{
  \panel{1.55+3.11*\i}{-0.40}{f7_control_\k.png}
}
\node[anchor=east, font=\rowhd, text=ink] at (1.42,-1.47) {Control};

% ---- row 2 : drought stress ----------------------------------------------
\foreach \i/\k in {0/input, 1/gt, 2/yolov8, 3/yolo26, 4/mrcnn}{
  \panel{1.55+3.11*\i}{-2.78}{f7_drought_\k.png}
}
\node[anchor=east, font=\rowhd, text=ink] at (1.42,-3.79) {Drought};
\node[anchor=east, font=\rowhd, text=ink] at (1.42,-4.05) {stress};

% ---- legend ---------------------------------------------------------------
\fill[gcblue, rounded corners=1pt] (7.00,-5.40) rectangle ++(0.21,0.19);
\node[anchor=north west, font=\lgd, text=ink] at (7.30,-5.21) {guard-cell mask};
\fill[poreorg, rounded corners=1pt] (9.75,-5.40) rectangle ++(0.21,0.19);
\node[anchor=north west, font=\lgd, text=ink] at (10.05,-5.21) {pore mask};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
